title: What's New: Cost Adjustment (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Demo - Handling Failed Adjustments with Item Batches

features.name: Inventory Cost Adjustment Tool
features.description: A new tool for monitoring the outcome and performance of cost adjustment runs, featuring logging options, filtering capabilities, and the ability to track adjustment status across items, production orders, and assembly orders.
caveats: Requires consistent and correct data input to function properly
Item batches run in separate sessions requiring manual refresh to see latest results

features.name: Cost Adjustment Logging Options
features.description: Two logging modes available in the Inventory Setup: 'Errors only' to log only failed cost adjustment runs, or 'All' to provide full picture of all adjustment runs.

features.name: Item Batches for Cost Adjustment
features.description: Automated feature that divides items into separate batches for cost adjustment processing, isolating problematic items and rerunning adjustments on remaining items up to a configurable maximum retry attempts.
caveats: Item batches run in separate sessions requiring refresh to see results
Depends on configurable max retry attempts setting

features.name: Cost Adjustment Log Per Item
features.description: Page showing time taken to complete adjustment and cost difference resulted for each item, with ability to drill down to item-level details.

features.name: Cost Adjustment Log Per Run
features.description: Page showing information about which exact item failed during a cost adjustment run, including error message and error call stack for troubleshooting.

features.name: Exclude Item from Adjustment
features.description: Action to isolate problematic items from cost adjustment runs until the root cause is found and resolved.

features.name: Export Item Data
features.description: Diagnostic capability to export problematic items with all dependencies and related item tables to a text file for investigation in sandbox environments or to attach to support requests.

features.name: Reset Cost Adjusted Toggle
features.description: Diagnostic action to reset the 'cost adjusted' toggle on items, production orders, and assembly orders so they will be included in the next cost adjustment run.

features.name: Costing Issues Detection Report
features.description: Diagnostic report that identifies data inconsistencies and common problems with data that customers have run into before.

features.name: Delete Item Data
features.description: Sandbox-only diagnostic action that prepares a clean environment for investigating problematic items without interference from other items.

features.name: Cost Adjustment Methods
features.description: Business Central offers four ways to run cost adjustment: automatic on posting each transaction, by schedule in non-business hours, on special occasions like inventory counting or period closing, and via the new Inventory Cost Adjustment Tool.
